name: Dark Farms
description: End-game hidden threat. An overdeveloped colony may grow a hidden self-replicating factory that builds robot troops and armed sleeper freighters for free. When it turns, the Harvester Collective rises from inside the colony and spreads by invading weakly garrisoned worlds. Trace scanners and spies can find the farms first.
